caveats: All 34 are named Wizards token-product or token-component crosswalks, not literal confirmation of Scryfall's t-prefix set codes; Scryfall supplies the exact catalog code and explicit parent link.

Some Wizards articles enumerate token designs, helper cards and product slots but do not thereby certify an exhaustive set/collector-number printing manifest, exact Scryfall token subset membership, or game-card debuts.
Tokens and emblems are gameplay accessories and not additional deckbuilding cards or standalone expansion releases; their existence cannot change legal deck counts or format legality.
Regional promo-token variants, substitute cards, uncertain Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Eternal token grouping, and other ambiguous family boundaries stay source-pending.
